import ezdxf
from ezdxf import bbox
before = {e.dxf.handle: str(e.dxf.all_existing_dxf_attribs()) for e in msp}
assert 'A3' not in doc.layouts.names(), 'A3 layout already exists'
lay = doc.layouts.new('A3')
lay.page_setup(size=(420,297), margins=(0,0,0,0), units='mm', offset=(0,0), rotation=0, scale=(1,1), name='ISO A3 (420.00 x 297.00 MM)')
lay.dxf.plot_type = 5
lay.dxf.plot_paper_units = 1
lay.dxf.plot_origin_x_offset = 0
lay.dxf.plot_origin_y_offset = 0
if 'A3_VIEWPORT' not in doc.layers:
    doc.layers.new('A3_VIEWPORT', dxfattribs={'color':7, 'plot':0})
ext = bbox.extents(msp)
mc = ((ext.extmin.x+ext.extmax.x)/2, (ext.extmin.y+ext.extmax.y)/2)
vp = lay.add_viewport(center=(220,168.5), size=(370,227), view_center_point=mc, view_height=454, status=2, dxfattribs={'layer':'A3_VIEWPORT'})
vp.dxf.flags = int(vp.dxf.flags) | 16384
vp.dxf.view_direction_vector = (0,0,1)
vp.dxf.view_target_point = (0,0,0)
vp.dxf.view_twist_angle = 0
lay.set_current_viewport_handle(vp.dxf.handle)
doc.layouts.set_active_layout('A3')
after = {e.dxf.handle: str(e.dxf.all_existing_dxf_attribs()) for e in msp}
assert before == after, 'Model entities changed'
result = {'layout':'A3','paper_mm':[lay.dxf.paper_width,lay.dxf.paper_height],'viewport_handle':vp.dxf.handle,'viewport_bounds':[[35,55],[405,282]],'viewport_scale':vp.dxf.height/vp.dxf.view_height,'model_extents':[list(ext.extmin),list(ext.extmax)],'model_view_center':list(mc),'model_unchanged':before==after,'viewport_locked':bool(vp.dxf.flags & 16384)}

item.text: 布局和图框已保存。首次校验发现两类问题：requirements 的文字字段应为 `contains`，轮廓需用图层区分；此外，校验器把模型空间中位于负坐标的尺寸误套进了纸张边界检查。我会修正校验参数，并直接核查布局中的纸张尺寸、视口范围、比例及标注是否完整可见。
